<template>
  <section class="destinations">
    <DestinationCard
      v-for="destination in displayedDestinations"
      :key="destination.id"
      :image="destination.image"
      :title="destination.name"
      :description="destination.description"
    />
  </section>
</template>

<script>
import axios from 'axios';
import DestinationCard from './DestinationCard.vue';

export default {
  name: 'HomePage',
  components: {
    DestinationCard
  },
  data() {
    return {
      destinations: [],
      displayedDestinations: []
    };
  },
  created() {
    this.fetchAttractions();
  },
  methods: {
    async fetchAttractions() {
      try {
        const response = await axios.get('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/attractions');
        this.destinations = response.data;
        this.selectRandomDestinations();
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('无法获取景点数据:', error);
      }
    },
    selectRandomDestinations() {
      const shuffled = this.destinations.sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
      this.displayedDestinations = shuffled.slice(2,3);
    }
  }
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.destinations {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
}
</style>
